The '''Library of Ashurbanipal''' is the reference wiki of the MELEK ecosystem, published at wiki.soapbox.community. It is named for the Neo-Assyrian royal library at Nineveh.

== Editorial model ==
Articles are served read-only and rendered server-side. Each carries its own ''References'' section recording provenance, and a ''Coverage'' note stating what the article does and does not establish. Where a cited source has been flagged in fact-checking, the flag is displayed to the reader rather than suppressed, so that disputed material is visible as disputed.

A publication filter governs what may appear: only designated article files are served, and private corpus domains are excluded at the publish layer as well as at generation.

== Scope ==
Coverage includes blockchain and Graphene topics, the ecosystem's own surfaces, and a plant-medicine and harm-reduction reference corpus.
